name: Gabriel
loreTies: Source: Heavenly city/ladder (ascent, gates, vaults, Jacob's Ladder)
shortBackstory: Gabriel is the dawnborn axis — the Heavenly Ladder-source whose renewal engine draws power from the ascent itself. He creates energy through the act of rising.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Gabriel was born from the ladder — the ascent connecting mortal to divine. He is the battery who renews through the power of rising. Ancient humans saw Jacob's Ladder — but they saw the ladder and missed the engine. Ascent is self-generating.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Empyrean, Gabriel is the reason the faction can always climb higher. His dawnborn axis generates energy through ascending. He works with Michael — Michael defines the ranks, and Gabriel provides the energy to climb them.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Gabriel by making his ladder lead nowhere. The Hollow removed the destination — the top of the ladder stopped existing. Climbing toward nothing does not generate power; it generates exhaustion.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In the Empyrean Choir Vault, Gabriel powers the Empyrean ascent. His heavenly-ladder staff generates renewal through climbing. But the Hollow removes the top of the ladder, and climbing toward nothing exhausts.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Gabriel's flaw is that he has never been able to descend. His ascent-nature means he is always climbing. The Hollow teaches him that a ladder goes both ways, and the being who can only climb cannot rescue anyone below.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
